status.description: found: the path answered. not_found: it looked and found nothing. refused: it declined (out of scope or not permitted). unavailable: it could not run.

claim.description: One checkable statement, not a summary. For anything but found, what the path reported.

identifier.description: Enough to repeat the retrieval: the tool call and its arguments.

confidence.description: Set by the path's own rule, so compare it within a path, not across paths.

cost_tokens.description: Estimated as characters / 4 of what the path returned.

freshness.description: When the source last changed, ISO 8601.
